Visual identity release, plus one alerting fix.

## Changes

- **New logo** everywhere:
  - favicon, home-screen icons (192 and 512 px) and web app manifest;
  - sidebar and sign-in screen;
  - header of PDF and HTML reports (embedded, no external resource);
  - README and a GitHub social preview image.
- **Coherent colors.** The interface accent follows the logo's purple (buttons, links, navigation, canaries). Yellow is now reserved for warnings and pending states, and the "probable / exposed" verdict moves to orange so it no longer looks like the brand color. Report verdict colors follow the same scheme.
- **Catalog wording** updated: every checker is a signed plugin.

## Fix

- **Honeytoken alerts.** The DNS requests of a single canary read are recorded concurrently, so two of them could each miss the other and raise two alerts. The decision and insert now run under a PostgreSQL transaction lock per token, so one read raises exactly one alert. Found by CI and verified over 15 runs with the race detector.

## Upgrade

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/eizi0/opencvec:v0.1.1
docker compose up -d
```

No database change is needed beyond the automatic migrations.
